guideline: Thank you for attending our human evaluation. Social media users would comment on a post to express their opinions. You are asked to check which comment is of higher quality for a certain post (comment 1 or 2). Please consider factors such as relevance to the post, tone, suitability for the social platform (for the use of hashtags), etc. Please do not consider the length and grammatical errors of the comment. If you think two comments are of equal quality, please subjectively choose the one you like.
